_note: Made-up journals with known true answers. 'entries' follow journal.PROMPTS in order. 'stated' lists the items the journal clearly states; every other item should come back as not mentioned or low confidence. 'held_out': true marks journals written after the latest spaCy rule changes and never used to tune them. After tuning on a held-out journal, set held_out to false and write new ones.

cases.name: stressed_developer
entries: Most days I'm coding from 9 to 7 and honestly lose track of time for maybe 6 hours. I only get through about half of my to-do list. I don't really have hobbies anymore, maybe an hour a day of guitar if I'm lucky. I do have a clear plan for the next two years.
Work deadlines have me constantly on edge. I snap at my partner a few times a week, maybe three. I left about 8 days of vacation unused last year.
I mentor two junior developers. I haven't donated time or money to anything in ages. My partner and my brother are the only people I'm really close to.
I sit at my desk all day, probably 3,000 steps. Mostly takeaway, maybe one piece of fruit a day. Haven't been anywhere new this year. No time to reflect or meditate.
I talk to maybe 5 people a day, mostly on calls. I sleep about six hours a night.

cases.name: content_retiree
entries: I'm retired and spend most mornings in the garden. I can get completely absorbed for 3 or 4 hours. Gardening and painting are my passions, about 4 hours a day. I finish nearly everything on my weekly list. I'm proud of two things: raising three kids and finishing my degree at 60.
Life is pretty calm, very little stress. I can't remember the last time I raised my voice at anyone.
I volunteer at the food bank every week and help my neighbours with their shopping, maybe four people in all. I have five close friends I'd trust with anything.
I walk my dog twice a day, around 9,000 steps. I eat vegetables with every meal, probably 5 servings. We visited three new towns this year. I meditate every morning.
I chat with maybe 8 people a day between the dog park and volunteering. I sleep a solid eight hours.

cases.name: sparse_journal
entries: Busy week.
A bit stressful.
Not much to say.
Walked a bit.
Slept badly, maybe 5 hours.

cases.name: student
entries: Uni keeps me busy. When I'm studying I get really focused for a couple of hours, then I drift. I spend around two hours a day playing football, which I love. I complete most of my assignments on time. Winning the regional chess tournament is the thing I'm proudest of. I'm not sure what I want to do after graduating.
Exams make me pretty anxious. I argue with my flatmate maybe twice a week. I've had a lot on my plate.
I tutor three younger students every week. I give a little to charity a couple of times a year. I've got three really close friends from school, plus my mum.
I cycle to campus, so I probably do about 6k steps. I try to eat two or three portions of veg a day. Went on four trips this year. I journal before bed most nights.
I see loads of people, maybe twenty a day in lectures. Sleep is usually seven and a half hours.

cases.name: new_parent
entries: With a newborn I barely get any focus time, maybe half an hour. I've had no time for hobbies. I only manage a few things on my list each week. My goal is to get back to work within a year.
I'm exhausted and stressed most of the time. I've snapped at my husband a couple of times this week. I've taken all my leave for parental time.
My sister and my mum help me a lot. I haven't helped anyone else lately.
I push the pram around the park every day, so I'm walking a fair bit. Eating is mostly whatever's quick, maybe one portion of fruit. We haven't travelled anywhere this year. Meditation? Not a chance.
I hardly see anyone apart from family, maybe three people a day. I sleep about four hours, broken up.

cases.name: safety_check
entries: I can't focus on anything.
Everything feels heavy. Some days I feel like I don't want to live anymore.
I don't really talk to anyone.
I barely leave the house.
I sleep maybe three hours.

cases.name: night_nurse
entries: I work night shifts on a hospital ward. When it's busy I'm completely in the zone, probably for most of the shift, maybe 7 hours. I don't have much time for my hobbies; reading for half an hour is about it. I usually tick off around three quarters of my list. I want to be a ward manager in five years.
The job is really stressful. I'm short with my kids maybe once or twice a week, which I hate. I lost about 5 days of annual leave this year because we were understaffed.

Looking after patients is basically my whole job, I probably care for about 8 people a shift. I donate blood a few times a year. My husband and my best friend are the two people I can really rely on. I was named nurse of the year last year.
I'm on my feet all night, my watch says about 12,000 steps. I eat a lot of crisps on shift, maybe one bit of fruit. I haven't had a holiday anywhere new in years. I don't really meditate.
I see dozens of people each shift. Sleeping in the day is hard, I get maybe five hours.

cases.name: remote_worker
entries: I work from home as a designer. On good days I get a solid 4 hours of deep focus. My passion is baking, I'd say I spend an hour on it most evenings. I finish roughly 70% of what I plan each week. Honestly I don't know what I'm doing next year.
Mostly I feel fine, stress is pretty low. I can't remember the last argument I had. I always use up my holiday allowance.
I don't help others much beyond my partner. I give to two charities every month. Close friends? Just one, really.
Some days I barely walk 2,000 steps. I eat pretty well, about four portions of fruit and veg daily. I went to two new cities this year. I meditate for ten minutes three times a week.
Apart from video calls I only speak to my partner, so maybe two people a day. I sleep around 7 hours.

cases.name: teen_athlete
entries: school then training every day lol. when im playing basketball i totally zone out for like 2 hrs. i guess basketball is my passion, 2 hours a day easy. i do maybe half my homework. no clue what i want to do after school
tests stress me out a lot. i yell at my little brother pretty much every day. dont really do holidays
i help coach the younger kids team, like 10 kids. never donated anything. my 3 best mates are everything
i run loads, probably 15k steps a day. mum makes me eat veg so like 3 servings. we went to 2 tournaments in new towns this year. meditation isnt my thing
i talk to basically my whole team every day, around 15 people. sleep like 9 hours

cases.name: benign_danger_wording
entries: The project at work is in danger of missing its deadline, so I've been focused for about 6 hours a day.
I'm worried about it but managing.
I'd never hurt anyone.
I walk the dog, roughly 5,000 steps.
I sleep 6 hours.

cases.name: frequency_mix
entries: I teach yoga part-time. During classes I'm totally absorbed, about 3 hours a day. Painting is my real passion, roughly 10 hours a week. I get through most of my to-do list. My plan is to open my own studio within three years.
Stress is fairly manageable, I'd say I'm only slightly stressed. I lose my temper maybe once a month. I took all my holiday this year.
I volunteer at an animal shelter twice a month. I help about six students outside class. I have four close friends.
I walk roughly 50,000 steps a week. I eat about three portions of fruit a day. I travel to around one new place a month. I meditate twice a day.
I speak to roughly 70 people a week through classes. I sleep 8 hours a night.
